spells.name: Acid Splash
spells.description: You create an acidic bubble at a point within range. Each creature in a 5-foot Sphere must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 Acid damage.

spells.name: Eldritch Blast
spells.description: You hurl a beam of crackling energy. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Force damage.

spells.name: Fire Bolt
spells.description: You hurl a mote of fire. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Fire damage.

spells.name: Guidance
spells.description: You touch a willing creature. The creature adds 1d4 to one ability check of its choice.

spells.name: Light
spells.description: You touch one object. Until the spell ends, the object sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range.

spells.name: Prestidigitation
spells.description: This spell is a minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice.

spells.name: Sacred Flame
spells.description: The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 1d8 Radiant damage.

spells.name: Thaumaturgy
spells.description: You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.description: Target must succeed on Wisdom save or take 1d6 Psychic damage and have Disadvantage on next attack.

spells.name: Bless
spells.description: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

spells.name: Burning Hands
spells.description: Each creature in a 15-foot Cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d6 Fire damage on fail.

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.description: One Humanoid makes a Wisdom save or has the Charmed condition.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.description: A creature you touch regains 2d8 + spellcasting modifier Hit Points.

spells.name: Detect Magic
spells.description: You sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you.

spells.name: Guiding Bolt
spells.description: Ranged spell attack. On hit: 4d6 Radiant damage; next attack against target has Advantage.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.description: A creature regains 2d4 + spellcasting modifier Hit Points.

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.description: Target's base AC becomes 13 + Dexterity modifier.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.description: Three darts deal 1d4+1 Force damage each.

spells.name: Shield
spells.description: You have a +5 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

spells.name: Thunderwave
spells.description: Each creature in a 15-foot Cube makes a Constitution save, taking 2d8 Thunder damage on fail.

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.description: Target Humanoid makes Wisdom save or is Paralyzed.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.description: Target has the Invisible condition until it attacks or casts a spell.

spells.name: Misty Step
spells.description: You teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

spells.name: Scorching Ray
spells.description: Three rays, each dealing 2d6 Fire damage on a hit.

spells.name: Spiritual Weapon
spells.description: Spectral weapon attacks for 1d8 + spellcasting modifier Force damage.

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.description: Interrupt a creature casting a spell. Target makes Constitution save or spell fails.

spells.name: Dispel Magic
spells.description: End spells of 3rd level or lower on the target.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.description: Each creature in a 20-foot Sphere makes Dexterity save, taking 8d6 Fire damage on fail.

spells.name: Fly
spells.description: Target gains a Fly Speed of 60 feet.

spells.name: Haste
spells.description: Target's Speed doubles, +2 AC, Advantage on Dex saves, extra action each turn.

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.description: Each creature in a 100-foot line makes Dexterity save, taking 8d6 Lightning damage on fail.

spells.name: Revivify

components.material: a diamond worth 300+ GP, which the spell consumes

spells.description: Touch a creature that died within the last minute. It returns to life with 1 Hit Point.

spells.name: Spirit Guardians
spells.description: Spirits protect you. Creatures entering or starting turn in emanation take 3d8 Radiant damage (Wisdom save for half).

spells.name: Banishment
spells.description: Target makes Charisma save or is banished to a harmless demiplane.

spells.name: Dimension Door
spells.description: Teleport yourself and one willing creature to a location within range.

spells.name: Greater Invisibility
spells.description: Target has the Invisible condition for the duration.

spells.name: Polymorph
spells.description: Transform a creature into a Beast form.

spells.name: Wall of Fire
spells.description: Create a wall of fire. Creatures within 10 feet take 5d8 Fire damage.

spells.name: Cone of Cold
spells.description: Each creature in a 60-foot Cone makes Constitution save, taking 8d8 Cold damage on fail.

spells.name: Hold Monster
spells.description: Target creature makes Wisdom save or is Paralyzed.

spells.name: Mass Cure Wounds
spells.description: Up to six creatures regain 5d8 + spellcasting modifier Hit Points.

spells.name: Raise Dead

components.material: a diamond worth 500+ GP, which the spell consumes

spells.description: Return a dead creature to life if it died within 10 days.

spells.name: Wall of Force
spells.description: Create an invisible wall of force. Nothing can physically pass through it.

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.description: Lightning arcs to up to four targets. Each makes Dexterity save, taking 10d8 Lightning damage on fail.

spells.name: Disintegrate
spells.description: Target makes Dexterity save, taking 10d6+40 Force damage on fail.

spells.name: Heal
spells.description: Target regains 70 Hit Points and is cured of Blindness, Deafness, and diseases.

spells.name: Finger of Death
spells.description: Target makes Constitution save, taking 7d8+30 Necrotic damage on fail, half on success.

spells.name: Plane Shift

components.material: a forked metal rod attuned to a particular plane

spells.description: Transport yourself and up to eight willing creatures to another plane of existence.

spells.name: Power Word Stun
spells.description: If target has 150 HP or fewer, it has the Stunned condition.

spells.name: Meteor Swarm
spells.description: Four 40-foot Spheres deal 40d6 Fire damage (Dexterity save for half) each.

spells.name: Power Word Kill
spells.description: If target has 100 HP or fewer, it dies.

spells.name: Wish
spells.description: The mightiest spell a mortal can cast. State your wish and it happens.

spells.name: Elementalism
spells.description: You exert control over the elements, creating one of several minor effects.

spells.name: Sorcerous Burst
spells.description: You cast sorcerous energy at one creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 damage of a type you choose: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder.

spells.name: Starry Wisp
spells.description: You launch a mote of light at one creature or object within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Radiant damage, and until the end of your next turn, it emits Dim Light in a 10-foot radius and can't benefit from the Invisible condition.

spells.name: Chromatic Orb
spells.description: You hurl an orb of energy at a creature within range. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder for the orb. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 3d8 damage of the chosen type.

spells.name: Dissonant Whispers
spells.description: You whisper a discordant melody. The target must make a Wisdom save. On a fail, it takes 3d6 Psychic damage and must immediately use its Reaction to move as far away from you as possible. On a success, it takes half damage only.

spells.name: Divine Smite
spells.description: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your attack deals an extra 2d8 Radiant damage. If the target is a Fiend or Undead, it takes an extra 1d8 Radiant damage.

spells.name: Ensnaring Strike
spells.description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack, a mass of vines appears and wraps around it. The target must succeed on a Strength save or have the Restrained condition until the spell ends.

spells.name: Hex

components.material: the petrified eye of a newt

spells.description: You curse a creature. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage to the target whenever you hit it with an attack. Also, choose one ability. The target has Disadvantage on ability checks with that ability.

spells.name: Ice Knife
spells.description: You create a shard of ice and fling it at one creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 Piercing damage. Hit or miss, the shard then explodes. The target and each creature within 5 feet of it must succeed on a Dexterity save or take 2d6 Cold damage.

spells.name: Ray of Sickness
spells.description: A ray of sickening greenish energy lashes out toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 Poison damage and is Poisoned until the end of your next turn.

spells.name: Searing Smite
spells.description: As you hit the target, it takes an extra 1d6 Fire damage from the attack. At the start of each of its turns until the spell ends, the target takes 1d6 Fire damage and then makes a Constitution save. On a successful save, the spell ends.

spells.name: Dragon's Breath
spells.description: You touch a willing creature and choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. Until the spell ends, the creature can use a Bonus Action to exhale energy of the chosen type in a 15-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d6 damage of the chosen type on a fail, or half on a success.

spells.name: Mind Spike
spells.description: You drive a disorienting spike of psychic energy into the mind of one creature. The target makes a Wisdom save, taking 3d8 Psychic damage on a fail, or half on a success. On a failed save, you also know the target's location until the spell ends.

spells.name: Phantasmal Force
spells.description: You craft an illusion that takes root in the mind of a creature. The target makes an Intelligence save. On a fail, you create a phantasmal object, creature, or phenomenon that only the target can perceive. The phantasm deals 1d6 Psychic damage each turn.

spells.name: Vitriolic Sphere
spells.description: You point at a location within range, and a glowing 1-foot ball of emerald acid streaks there and explodes in a 20-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in that area makes a Dexterity save. On a fail, a creature takes 10d4 Acid damage and 5d4 Acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half the initial damage only.

spells.name: Charm Monster
spells.description: You attempt to charm a creature. It makes a Wisdom save, and it does so with Advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. On a failed save, it has the Charmed condition until the spell ends or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it.

spells.name: Summon Dragon

components.material: an object with the image of a dragon engraved on it worth 500+ GP

spells.description: You call forth a draconic spirit that appears in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The spirit uses the Draconic Spirit stat block.

spells.name: Tsunami
spells.description: A wall of water springs into existence at a point you choose. The wall is 300 feet long, 300 feet high, and 50 feet thick, and it lasts for the duration. Each creature in the wall makes a Strength save or takes 6d10 Bludgeoning damage.

spells.name: Power Word Heal
spells.description: A wave of healing energy washes over a creature you touch. The target regains all its Hit Points. If the creature has the Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or Stunned condition, the condition ends.
